description: This file defines chart-related models, enums, constants, and utility functions for a widget library in a larger project, including color schemes, shape types, line types, animation settings, fill types, label positions, and functions for creating gradients and styles.

methods.name: measureSymbolOffset
methods.description: Calculates the offset for a symbol based on its size and shape.

methods.name: createLinearOpacityGradient
methods.description: Creates a linear gradient object with specified color and opacity stops.

methods.name: createRadialOpacityGradient
methods.description: Creates a radial gradient object with specified color and opacity stops.

methods.name: createChartTextStyle
methods.description: Generates a text style object for chart labels and text elements.

methods.name: prepareChartThemeColor
methods.description: Adjusts color for dark mode, inverting or selecting theme-specific colors.

methods.name: toAnimationOption
methods.description: Converts chart animation settings into ECharts animation options.
